item.title: Iran And Oman Working To Control Strait Of Hormuz, Shaky Ceasefire Still Holding
item.summary: The U.S. and Iran aren't exchanging blows as Trump says he's given his final chance at a deal, and the strait remains the most urgent sticking point. The post Iran And Oman Working To Control Strait Of Hormuz, Shaky Ceasefire Still Holding appeared first on TWZ .
